paragraphs.text: Hogaak is a legendary avatar of graves from an unknown plane.

Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis, is an embodiment of death and decay, a towering Avatar whose very existence blurs the line between life and death. Emerging from an unknown world, Hogaak crawls as a colossal figure formed of graves, a lumbering city of bones and earth, animated by the dark energies of the necropolis it embodies.
